LLM auditresponse for zulu-8-jdk-fx.install:
<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The provided `zulu-8-jdk-fx.install` script is a standard Arch Linux package hook script used to manage JVM integration via the `archlinux-java` tool. It defines helper and lifecycle functions (`post_install`, `post_upgrade`, `pre_remove`) that ensure the Zulu JDK 8 with JavaFX is properly registered or unregistered as the system JVM when installed, upgraded, or removed.

The script uses a private function `_fix_default` to check the current default JVM by calling `/usr/bin/archlinux-java get`. If no default is set (or the java binary is missing), it returns nothing. During install and upgrade, if no default JVM is set, it sets the current package's JVM as the default. On removal, if the current package's JVM is the default, it unsets it to prevent dangling references. All operations are confined to expected system integration logic and use only safe, standard shell constructs and system binaries.

There are no network operations, file manipulations outside the JVM registration mechanism, use of eval, or execution of downloaded code. The script does not exfiltrate data or perform any out-of-scope actions. It follows standard practices for JVM packages in Arch Linux and poses no security risk.
</details>
<evidence>

</evidence>
<summary>
Standard JVM registration script, no malicious behavior</summary>
</security_assessment>
